title: Adding a Power BI workspace to Company Information to be used when deploying reports
summary: Company Information now supports configuring a Power BI Workspace to serve as the target destination for deploying Power BI reports from Business Central.
key_points: Power BI Workspace field added to the Reporting section of Company Information
The workspace is used as the deployment target for Deployable reports
New Power BI Workspaces Lookup page for selecting a workspace
Power BI synchronizer, upload interfaces and deployment table updated to carry the workspace
Change applied in the W1 layer and many country layers; depends on an upcoming platform uptake
